_meta.description: Grouped Process aggregating revenue by month decorated with an OVERLAY_INDEX_VS_PRIOR group overlay that scores each month against the immediately preceding month (current_month / previous_month * 100) — a month-over-month index. Streamable: the single-state lag carrier is one f64 per group, carried alongside the per-group accumulators inside the streaming Process fold. First-present-point semantics: January emits NaN (no prior available — distinct from divide-by-zero); February onward each emits feb/jan*100, mar/feb*100, and so on against orders.pulse's 2025 calendar-year span.
_meta.name: process-window-index-vs-prior
